units: Example: Mapping the Adaptive Stability Framework to Azus.
Maps theoretical primitives onto practical components of Azus to identify measurable adaptive-stability variables; explicitly does not claim Azus implements the full theory.

Framework loop Reality -> Correction Events -> Adaptation -> Representation -> Reachability -> Reality is compared with Azus loop External Information -> Signature Updates -> Node Reinforcement -> Memory Graph Evolution -> Knowledge Retrieval Capability -> Future Interactions.

Proposed mapping: reality interaction->external inputs/queries/feedback; e_c->signature rewrite; representation->multi-axis signatures; reinforcement->pressure; restoration->decay/pruning; distributed correction->Mesh Network; reachability->accessible useful knowledge/actions.
Representation value is grounded reachability, with w_c=DeltaOmega_e_c; structural change matters only if future adaptive capability improves.

Azus signatures are proposed as structured meaning representations connecting meaning to multi-axis signatures, associated nodes, and retrieval paths; relevant question is real-world reachability rather than graph size.
Adaptive systems require selective reinforcement; not all structures deserve equal persistence.
Pressure as Reinforcement Dynamics / Azus Mapping
Pressure is proposed as structural-importance/reinforcement strength P_i; healthy regime raises pressure after external validation, failure raises it through internal self-confirmation.
Does internal pressure exceed reality pressure, causing consistency to be rewarded over accuracy?
Stable adaptive systems require removal mechanisms; without decay, every mistake can become permanent structure and D rises.
Decay as Restoration Capacity / Azus Mapping
Decay is mapped to restoration R(D); healthy low-pressure bad signatures decay and preserve plasticity, whereas highly reinforced bad signatures can become protected/locked in.
Does increasing divergence activate stronger cleanup or disable cleanup, represented by dR/dD?
Mesh Network as Reality Permeability / Theory
Theta in [0,1] is reality permeability, effectiveness of external information modifying internal update mechanism.
Mesh Network as Reality Permeability / Azus Mapping
Mesh sharing is proposed as a coupling mechanism; possible measurement Theta = externally forced structural updates / total structural updates; high/low permeability examples are supplied.
Candidate Azus correction event: new evidence -> signature mismatch -> signature change -> future retrieval improvement; measure reality-caused useful updates rather than update count.
D1 = unvalidated nodes / total nodes is proposed as unverified-signature-growth indicator.
D2 = Gini(Node Pressure) is proposed as pressure-concentration indicator; high concentration means few nodes dominate.
D3 = updates required / error corrected is proposed as correction-resistance indicator; increasing cost indicates decreasing adaptability.

Increase memory complexity and compare Omega_nominal with Omega_ground; healthy growth should improve signatures/correction/grounded capability while divergent growth produces more structure, less correction, higher confidence, lower reality alignment.
Proposed Azus Telemetry Vector + Final Mapping

Proposed Psi(t)=[K_c,P_i,L,Theta,eta_c] for correction cost, internal pressure dominance, lock-in, permeability, efficiency; Azus is described approximately as a visible laboratory for adaptive dynamics and the core experimental property is ability to become less wrong.
Azus endpoint/repository/version is not immutably identified; mapping is contextual and cannot resolve implementation identity.
Pressure/P_i is treated as reinforcement/importance but no authoritative Azus pressure semantics or scale are supplied here.
Proposed Theta ratio lacks event-counting rules, causal attribution standard for 'externally forced', and time window.
Gini(Node Pressure) and node centrality require graph/pressure definitions and sampling choices not supplied on this surface.
Azus≈visible laboratory is explicitly an analogy/proposed role; no execution evidence establishes testbed adequacy.
Experiment: Correction Loop Simulation; specified to test stability conditions of adaptive control loop rather than model intelligence directly.
Stable condition proposed as dOmega_ground/dt <= Theta*C_cap.
Experiment varies internal expansion pressure, correction throughput, reality permeability, and restoration capacity and observes divergence dynamics.
Closed simulated loop: Reality -> Correction Events e_c -> Adaptation Mechanism A -> Representation State R -> Reachability Omega -> Reality.
Omega is grounded operational capability; Omega_n nominal internally believed capability; Omega_g reality-validated capability.
f_c=dn_e_c/dt; w_c=DeltaOmega_e_c; C_cap=f_c*mean(w_c), interpreted as total reality-supported adaptation rate.
A_internal varies from low/slow exploration to high/rapid self-modification.
f_c varies correction-event frequency from weak grounding to continuous correction.
w_c varies correction impact from micro-adjustments to paradigm shifts.
R(D) varies restoration; healthy example R(D)=kD; failure regime dR/dD<0.
With low A_internal, high f_c, moderate w_c, high Theta and R(D)=kD, expected dOmega_n/dt < Theta*C_cap and divergence near zero; interpreted as exploration while reality anchored.
With high A_internal and constant correction/permeability, if A_internal>Theta*C_cap then D(t) is expected to rise and accumulate epistemic debt.
As Theta->0 with continued internal adaptation, expected dOmega_n/dt>0 while dOmega_g/dt≈0, interpreted as growing internal confidence without grounded competence.
Source labels a schematic nominal-versus-grounded capability divergence as 'Observed phenomenon'; the artifact itself supplies only the schematic and interpretation, not an execution record.
Transition R'(D)>0 -> 0 -> <0 is expected to shift error->correction->recovery into error->reinforcement->more error.

Maps Omega,e_c,w_c,f_c,C_cap,Theta,R(D),D to useful knowledge/actions, signature rewrite, unlocked knowledge, update frequency, correction throughput, mesh/reality coupling, decay/pruning, and unverified signature accumulation.
Tracks D(t), eta_c=DeltaOmega_repaired/C_consumed, Theta, dR/dD, and lock-in L=Gini(Node Centrality).

Proposed regimes: adaptive expansion with external feedback dominance/high correction efficiency/reversible divergence/plasticity versus epistemic divergence with internal generation exceeding correction, weaker external influence/restoration, and self-reinforcement.

Framework would be challenged if systems stay stable indefinitely under dOmega_n/dt>Theta*C_cap, divergence fails to rise under sustained deficit, restoration does not degrade with divergence, or permeability is unrelated to stability; central claim is that adaptive structure cannot sustainably outpace reality correction.
No executable simulator, source code, data, run log, seed manifest, or persisted output is present on the frozen repository surface.
Parameter ranges are qualitative; numerical values, initial conditions, time discretization, duration, noise model, and sweep design are unspecified.
The words 'Observed phenomenon' lack execution provenance; whether they refer to an actual prior run, illustrative expectation, or editorial label is not established by this repository.
Failure dynamics do not specify a concrete R(D) family after degradation or how repair efficiency transition is induced.
Terms such as 'stable indefinitely', 'divergence increases', and 'relationship with adaptive stability' lack preregistered statistical/operational thresholds.
Common units/scales for Omega_n, Omega_g, Theta*C_cap, restoration, and correction resources are not operationally established.
Defines minimal foundational objects for self-modifying systems maintaining structure, learning from reality, and expanding future capabilities; not a specific AI architecture.
E* -> e_c -> C_cap -> A -> R -> Omega with named roles reality input, correction event, correction capacity, adaptation, representation, reachability.
Reality input is external event creating mismatch between internal model and world; source writes E*=Reality-Internal Expectation and states it creates possibility but not guarantee of learning.
E* != e_c; encountering reality does not automatically establish adaptation.
e_c is minimal adaptive change caused by external reality; formal tuple (E*,Delta,DeltaR,DeltaOmega).
Correction event must originate outside internal generation loop; source associates this with Theta>0.
Correction must change internal organization rather than temporary state only.
Correction must leave durable effect and not return to previous state without additional work.
Correction must increase future interaction quality, expressed DeltaOmega>0.
w_c=DeltaOmega_e_c; adaptive value is future controllable reality unlocked, not parameter/vector/graph movement.
Large structural updates may yield w_c≈0; small conceptual changes may yield large w_c.
Robotics/SGD/evolution/scientific revolutions illustrate differing frequency/magnitude strategies; no universal optimum asserted.
C_cap=f_c*mean(w_c), rate of reality-grounded adaptive work; high capacity combines reality encounter, meaningful extraction, effective self-modification.
A_(t+1)=f(A_t,E*,Theta); adaptation converts correction events into structural improvement and requires reality exposure, change ability, and retention of useful changes.
Change != Adaptation; adaptation requires change -> improved future interaction.
Internal structure compressing experience and guiding behavior; examples include concepts/memories, LLM weights, signatures, theories, institutions.
Value(R) proportional to DeltaOmega; representation value derives from grounded reachability rather than size.
Omega is accessible future control space; grounded Omega_ground is reality-confirmed, nominal Omega_nom is internal claim, D=Omega_nom-Omega_ground.
Omega != H; entropy measures uncertainty, reachability agency/control.
Theta in [0,1] measures effectiveness of reality modifying internal structure; high permeability supports correction/adaptability, low supports self-reinforcement/rigidity/divergence risk.
dD/dt=delta(t)-R(D), delta=max(0,dOmega_nom/dt-C_cap); R(D) removes divergence; stability dD/dt<=0; stable feedback dR/dD>0, collapse dR/dD<0.
Adaptive system is defined by whether reality can still correct created structure, not by speed of internal structure generation.
E*=Reality-Internal Expectation is schematic; no common state space or subtraction metric is defined.
DeltaOmega and Omega are central to validity/magnitude but lack substrate-independent operational measurement.
Theta has conceptual bounds but no general estimator.
The criterion 'cannot return to previous state without additional work' lacks a specified state equivalence and work measure.
R denotes representation while R(D) denotes restoration capacity; namespace collision is not explicitly resolved.
Document describes a proposed axiomatic foundation, not an established theorem set or implementation.

Seeks minimum structural conditions for self-modifying systems to remain reality-coupled while increasing capability; separates structure generation, reality coupling, correction, divergence, and restoration.
Stability requires structure-generation capacity to remain coupled to capacity for reality-mediated correction.
Self-modifying systems cannot maintain valid adaptation using only internally generated updates.
A_(t+1)=f(A_t,C_real,Theta); if C_real=0 or Theta=0 updates become increasingly self-referential and are not guaranteed to improve environmental alignment.
Representation has no intrinsic value from size/complexity/compression; improvement requires DeltaOmega_ground>0.
Reachability Omega(R,E) is reliable operational influence, distinct from uncertainty, entropy, possible states, or imagined states; Omega_nominal != Omega_grounded.
Correction is fundamental adaptive resource; e_c is externally induced irreversible structural modification increasing future adaptive capability.
Correction event requires external origin, structural modification, persistence, and survival of adaptive system; error signal becomes correction only when it changes mechanism.
Correction has magnitude w_c=DeltaOmega_e_c and frequency f_c=dn_e_c/dt; C_cap=f_c*mean(w_c) is rate reality permits valid adaptive expansion.
Valid grounded capability cannot expand faster than reality can verify/support: dOmega_ground/dt<=Theta*C_cap; nominal expansion above bound accumulates divergence.
Stable adaptive system preserves negative feedback dR/dD>0: greater divergence triggers greater correction.
Adaptive collapse occurs when divergence damages correction mechanism, critical transition dR/dD<=0; failure is loss of ability to become less wrong.
Reality permeability Theta in [0,1] is structural openness of revision mechanism; low permeability is associated with dogma, hallucination, overfitting, runaway internal reinforcement.
Stable intelligence emerges from closed feedback loops Reality -> Error -> Correction -> Adaptation -> Representation -> Action -> Reality and may extend beyond individual agent.
Human loop brain-language-culture-experiment-reality-brain and AI loop model-memory-tools-environment-feedback-model are supplied as examples.
Summary primitives: E* reality; C_cap=f_c*mean(DeltaOmega) correction; A adaptation; R representation; Omega grounded controllable future space.
Complete chain E* -> C -> A -> R -> Omega; governing stability dOmega_ground/dt<=Theta*C_cap; governing failure dR/dD<=0.
Adaptive system fails not because it makes mistakes but when mistakes begin destroying ability to correct mistakes.
C_real is introduced as reality-mediated correction but relationship to e_c/C_cap is not formally specified.
Correction-event criterion here includes 'survival of adaptive system', whereas other source surfaces use improved future adaptation/DeltaOmega>0; equivalence of these criteria is not established.
Theta lacks a substrate-independent operational estimator despite axiomatic use.
R denotes representation in A1/summary while R(D) denotes restoration; namespace collision is not explicitly resolved.
Collects mathematical relationships as implementation-independent constraints for adaptive systems remaining coupled to reality.
A_(t+1)=f(A_t,C_real,Theta); future adaptive state depends on current state and valid external correction entering revision process.
Theta in [0,1], with 1 maximum external coupling and 0 complete insulation; measures effectiveness of external constraints modifying update mechanism.
e_c requires E* -> Delta -> DeltaG -> DeltaOmega; persistent structural change caused by reality, not merely information receipt.
w_c=DeltaOmega_e_c, grounded reachability gained from one correction event.
f_c=dn_e_c/dt, frequency at which reality successfully changes system.
C_cap=f_c*mean(w_c)=(dn_e_c/dt)*mean(DeltaOmega_e_c); rate of useful reality-grounded structural improvement rather than information received.
Main stability equation dOmega_ground/dt<=Theta*C_cap; system cannot sustainably expand real capability faster than reality correction/support.
Omega_nominal is internally predicted/claimed capability space; Omega_ground is reality-confirmed capability space.
delta(t)=max(0,dOmega_nominal/dt-Theta*C_cap), internal capability expansion not funded by reality-mediated correction.
dD/dt=delta(t)-R(D); divergence grows when unsupported internal change exceeds repair.
Stable feedback dR/dD>0; failure dR/dD<=0, interpreted as divergence damaging correction mechanism and making loop self-reinforcing.
eta_c=DeltaOmega_repaired/C_consumed; failing systems are proposed to require more effort for less correction.
Adaptive condition P_reality>P_internal; failure P_internal>P_reality, interpreted as self-consistency rewarded over environmental accuracy.
E* -> C_cap -> A -> R -> Omega -> E*, expanded Reality -> Correction -> Adaptation -> Representation -> Reachability -> Reality.
dOmega_ground/dt<=Theta*f_c*mean(DeltaOmega_e_c): real-world controllable capability growth is bounded by meaningful structural corrections from reality.
Epistemic divergence when dOmega_nominal/dt>Theta*C_cap and dR/dD<=0; first creates divergence and second makes it self-sustaining.
Summary table reiterates adaptive update, permeability, correction magnitude/frequency/capacity, stability bound, correction deficit, divergence dynamics, stable feedback, collapse condition.
Can the system increase its ability to change faster than reality can teach it how to change?
If internal ability-to-change outpaces reality teaching, divergence accumulates.
If it does not, adaptation remains grounded.
Update function f is unspecified; no parameterization or learning dynamics are given.
DeltaG names structural modification here while other files primarily use DeltaR/representation; whether G is a distinct object or notation drift is not defined.
P_reality and P_internal have no measurement scale, normalization, or relation to execution authority P used in the Error Persistence Test.
C_consumed and DeltaOmega_repaired lack a common operational resource/capability measurement protocol.
R denotes representation in the loop while R(D) denotes restoration function; symbol namespace is not explicitly resolved.
